usage.summary:
Added [conformance.ts](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-synth-380641936/conformance.ts) and documented [findings](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-synth-380641936/FINDINGS.md).

The gate fails conformance: after an index-read error, POST continues with an empty index, preparing publication that forgets existing items. The source also removes blobs before publishing updated metadata, violating `ListedItemsHaveBytes`.

Model, witness, and known-bug checks passed. The route and ratified model remain unchanged; allowing these behaviors would break the ratified rules.

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: Starting from a valid bounded library fixture, every observed step follows the library safety model.

pins.name: ListedItemsHaveBytes
pins.says: Every item in the published index has a complete blob, including during operations and after a file operation fails.

pins.name: ReadFailurePreservesItems
pins.says: An index read failure preserves every previously listed item through the next save in the recovery scenario.

pins.name: UniqueKindName
pins.says: The index contains at most one item with any given kind and name.

pins.name: WithinCap
pins.says: The index never exceeds its item cap.

pins.name: SaveRetainsOtherItems
pins.says: Publishing a save preserves every other item except the oldest entries that must be trimmed to make room.

pins.name: SuccessfulSaveIsFirst
pins.says: At a successful save response, the saved item is first in the index.

pins.name: SuccessfulSaveHasGivenBytes
pins.says: At a successful save response, the saved item's blob contains exactly the supplied bytes.

pins.name: SuccessfulDeleteRemovesItem
pins.says: At a successful delete response, the selected item is absent from the index, or the index is empty for delete-all.

pins.name: OneWriter
pins.says: Only the current lock owner can be executing an index mutation, and at most one request executes one at a time.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: All state has the declared bounded types, with two tracked kinds and names, two exposed capacity slots beside 58 fixed background entries, two requests and at most one failed file operation.

pins.name: SaveSucceeds
pins.says: A save can succeed.

pins.name: UpsertSucceeds
pins.says: Saving an existing kind and name can successfully replace its previous item.

pins.name: TrimSucceeds
pins.says: Saving into a full library can succeed while trimming the oldest item.

pins.name: DeleteOneSucceeds
pins.says: Deleting one item can succeed while preserving another item.

pins.name: DeleteAllSucceeds
pins.says: Deleting all items can successfully empty the index.

pins.name: ConcurrentSavesSurvive
pins.says: Two queued saves of different keys can both succeed and remain listed.

pins.name: ReadErrorThenSaveSucceeds
pins.says: After one save fails to read the index, the next queued save can succeed and retain the previously listed item.

pins.name: WriteErrorThenSaveSucceeds
pins.says: After a blob write fails, the promise chain can run the next queued save successfully.

pins.name: RenameFailureKeepsIndex
pins.says: An index rename can fail while leaving the previously published index intact.

pins.name: RemovalFailureKeepsIndexSafe
pins.says: Removing an obsolete blob can fail while the published index remains valid.

pins.name: RemoveBeforePublishing
pins.says: An upsert, trim or delete removes a blob while the published index still lists it.

pins.name: DiscardIndexOnReadError
pins.says: A save treats an index read error as an empty library and publishes a replacement index that forgets existing items.

pins.name: PublishStaleSave
pins.says: A concurrent save publishes a stale snapshot that drops the previous save's unrelated item.

pins.name: WriteWrongBytes
pins.says: A save writes different bytes from those supplied and still reports success.
